The provided onboarding document does not contain specific details regarding whether intermediate tool calls are expected to be streamed/published over the `/v1/chat/completions` API endpoint.

**Best Guess:**
When calling an agentic `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint where the server autonomously manages tool execution, the agent loop executes tools internally and only streams back the final generated assistant response (as shown in your output), rather than streaming intermediate `tool_calls` deltas to the client. If client-side tool execution or intermediate event streaming is needed, a dedicated events stream or standard non-agent model endpoint is typically used.
